exceptions.rationale: Torch 2.11.0 and 2.12.1 require setuptools<82. The advisory affects Unicode-normalization handling while building source distributions on macOS; Facetorch's official platform and release builders are Linux.
mitigations: Facetorch source distributions use an isolated setuptools>=83 build backend.
Release jobs reject non-Linux production targets.
The runtime environment does not invoke setuptools to build source distributions.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when validated Torch 2.11 and 2.12 patches no longer require vulnerable setuptools, or drop the affected runtime lines.

exceptions.rationale: The local denial-of-service advisory affects torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss. Facetorch does not call that API; Torch 2.6 remains the validated CUDA 12.4 production cohort alongside the separately validated Torch 2.7-2.13 runtime lines.
mitigations: Release contracts reject any Facetorch production-source use of ctc_loss while this exception exists.

Official configurations contain packaged transform graphs; image and tensor inputs cannot supply executable Python definitions.
